title: Exponential Local Search in Bounded-Occurrence MAX-CSP
summary: We study the number of improving steps that local search may require for $(2,2,r)$-MCA (Maximum Constraint Assignment), a bounded-occurrence version of MAX-CSP with valued constraints in which every constraint involves at most two variables, every variable occurs in at most two constraints, and every variable takes one of $r$ values. We consider the flip neighborhood, where two assignments are neighbors if they differ in the value of exactly one variable; moving to such a neighbor is called a flip.
